title: Federal Procurement & Acquisition Essentials
blurb: Three days on the acquisition lifecycle, FAR-grounded practice, source selection, and contract management — taught by practitioners who have built national procurement systems from the ground up.

modules.body:
Day 1

Requirements definition, market research, acquisition planning, and forecasting — with field-tested templates you keep.

The OECD and World Bank both identify procurement as a prime AI application in government — and a prime integrity risk. "Trustworthy AI" in acquisition means what this course teaches: transparent criteria, documented decisions, humans accountable for awards.

Day 2

Solicitation development, evaluation criteria, source-selection integrity, and documentation discipline.

🧪 Interactive Lab — try it now

Act as a procurement systems advisor. My institution: [describe]. Draft a gap assessment against good practice: policy framework, planning, solicitation, evaluation integrity, contract management, and audit readiness — rated red/amber/green with the single highest-impact fix per area and a 90-day corrective roadmap.

Day 3

Contract administration, modifications, performance management, risk registers, and compliance audit preparation.
